raw_text:
- To investigate the effect of work processes on completion times across similar sites.

Assumptions
- A common work process does not guarantee similar completion times.

Research design
- Quasi-experimental research design with pretest and posttest measurements.

Data or evidence needed
- Completion times of similar sites with the same nominal work process.

Measurement
- Completion times.

Analysis
- ANOVA to compare means; paired tests for pretest and posttest.

Decision / stopping rule
- Significance level of 0.05. A persistent difference in completion times across similar sites suggests the researchers should consider other factors affecting work processes (Bayes Factor).

Limitations
- Potential sampling error; uncontrolled external factors.
